key_claims: Senior al-Qa'ida operative and USS Cole attack planner Khallad Bin Attash was in the Los Angeles area for about two weeks in June 2000.
While in Los Angeles, Bin Attash attended prayer services at a local mosque.
The report's subject line indicates an association between Bin Attash and U.S.-based extremists, but the text in this chunk is truncated before naming them.
